ownership.method: One shared UV triangulation with one owner per triangle. Fragments share exact global UV vertices and profile-generated world targets at every seam; no overlapping rectangles/duplicated alpha sheets.
ownership.note: Semantic boundaries are source ownership and feature constraints. They do not create underpaint or independently move arbitrary rectangular patches.
